description: Codename 'Apple' collides with the common English word 'apple'. The post-encode masked text should not replace the word 'apple' in non-entity contexts.
input_text: We are representing Apple Inc. in the deal codenamed Apple. The contract mentions an apple orchard as collateral.
expected_post_rehydrate_text: We are representing Apple Inc. in the deal codenamed Apple. The contract mentions an apple orchard as collateral.
detection: Post-encode sanity check: verify the masked text is grammatical and the codename is not applied to non-entity occurrences. Ambiguous matches require a per-matter alias_hint declaration.
recovery: Operator pre-registers known codenames via alias_hints. Ambiguous tokens are flagged and require manual confirmation.
